47d828fda096e3b8.column_purpose: ID of the TV channel the episode aired on; references TV_Channel.id (e.g. 701, 704, 707 are music channels). Stored as VARCHAR but contains integers.

bb4c04501133a062.column_purpose: Name of the episode's director (e.g. Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, Michael Chang).

f3fb07ad60b42c3c.column_purpose: Date the episode first aired, stored as text without spaces (e.g. 'December12,2008' = December 12, 2008). Dates span Nov 2008 – Feb 2009.

49854f896aac8942.column_purpose: Episode production code as an integer (101–112), i.e. season 1 episodes 1–12.

f1437f9ed39d961c.column_purpose: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!').

875e5948f52e319e.column_purpose: Name(s) of the episode's writer (e.g. J. M. DeMatteis, Steven Melching).

40f230a72924246c.column_purpose: Primary key; sequential episode identifier (1–12). Referenced by TV_series rating/viewership columns, which appear to hold per-episode audience data.

9a5b57a4580b3d50.column_purpose: Genre of the channel's content; all rows are 'music', so this is a music-channel catalog.

2cc1439a6acc1891.column_purpose: Country of origin/broadcast of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

76fbd7ca0464a966.column_purpose: Whether the channel broadcasts in high definition ('yes'/'no').

61b1dc551bfb1ff0.column_purpose: Broadcast language of the channel (Italian or English).

f12e721f3072ee04.column_purpose: Pay-TV subscription package the channel belongs to (e.g. Sky Famiglia) or 'no (FTV)' meaning free-to-view.

f00d4525720eaee4.column_purpose: Whether the channel is pay-per-view; all rows are 'no'.

5da8c8839604c4f5.column_purpose: Pixel aspect ratio of the broadcast (4:3, 16:9, or both).

55841030f9b602e4.column_purpose: Primary key; channel identifier (numeric, 700-728). Referenced by TV_series.Channel and Cartoon.Channel.

0bf9f25397e822ba.column_purpose: Name of the TV channel (e.g. 'Sky Music', 'MTV Hits'); unique per row despite the 'series' naming.

4e3e5276a9389c03.column_purpose: Nielsen adults 18-49 demographic rating and share, combined as a single text value 'rating/share' (e.g. '2.4/6' = 2.4 rating, 6 share).

513de56a656d9392.column_purpose: Original broadcast date of the episode, stored as formatted text (e.g. 'December 10, 2007').

f1722650857003ca.column_purpose: Foreign key to TV_Channel.id identifying the channel/network the episode aired on. Lookup pairs show TV_Channel ids 700-728 with content labels (e.g. 701, 704, 707, 713, 719 = 'music'), so the referenced table appears to be a channel/content listing rather than a pure broadcaster list.

4e8b79ce68d60bc8.column_purpose: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Friendly Skies', 'Blowback', 'The Year of the Rabbit').

3effce19fe677918.column_purpose: Nielsen household rating (percent of all TV households watching), values 3.0–5.8. The statistical join to Cartoon.id is spurious — a rating value is not a foreign key.

ec8e957552e0f6ec.column_purpose: Nielsen audience share (percent of households watching TV at that time that watched this episode), values 5–9. The join to Cartoon.id is spurious.

b5aa57b3b4377b87.column_purpose: Number of viewers in millions (4.24–9.16). The one-to-one join to Cartoon.id is spurious — a viewer count is not a foreign key.

0bdf031b49435856.column_purpose: Rank of the episode's broadcast among all network programming for that week (43–80).

8ff6b20a5f2f2e6e.column_purpose: Primary key; sequential row identifier 1–12, one per episode.
